shared_elements: thin scratched/incised linear marks on a pale surface
long straight lines crossing the field
clusters of overlapping strokes forming irregular patterns
justification: Both surfaces carry only fine, sparse, purely linear incised marks with no infill or modelling, and both include long straight strokes crossing the field, which gives a superficial stylistic kinship. But what is depicted differs fundamentally: A shows a repertoire of script-like signs, vertical ruled framing lines and a lattice/crosshatch panel, all non-figurative and organised in columns and registers, whereas B shows loose curvilinear outlines that read as animal or figural bodies scattered without framing.
